items.limitation: Reviewed loose. No supported cap hair form; remove hats before equipping.

limits: Appearance approval covers the recorded outfits and sampled states, not every item combination or animation frame.
Native body motion is preserved. Front/Side/Back reframe the current pose; there is no in-place animation mode.
Happy and Angry are independent face choices that hold their final source frame. Pose synchronization and other expressions are unavailable.
Eye reset uses client colorpalette 3 entry 0 as the viewer default, not a verified character-creation default. Garments and hair use exported material override defaults.

Authored C hair forms were reviewed for Natural Shaggy Hair with both selected hats, Flowing Angel Hair with Casual Cap, and Apple Bob with Beginner Fishing Hat. Other pairings are not appearance-certified. Outlandish Locks is supported loose only.
Clipping, private bones, special materials and unsupported source formats can still affect preview items. No body part was resized or item silently substituted.
All effects and particle simulation are excluded. Weapons use source itemmodel attachment locations; combat poses are outside this six-clip set.
Local URLs and MIME types are tested. Hosted CORS, immutable cache headers and published-origin verification require the separately authorized deployment.
